title: The Successor Hold
description: A Dwarven successor hold survives beneath the old Golden Hills legacy. Its Forge-Thane is willing to receive you. Establish formal contact with this hold before deciding what place it will have in the new reign.
description_completed: Formal contact has been established with the designated Dwarven successor hold. Its political outcome remains unresolved.

dialogue.offer: You stand in a Dwarven hold, not a ruin waiting to be claimed. I am its Forge-Thane. If the dark tower has business with my people, speak it here.
dialogue.ready_to_turn_in: Then the formalities are done. You know who speaks for this hold, and I know whose claim has returned to the world above.
dialogue.completed: Our hold has heard you. What we become under this reign has not yet been decided.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign

rewards.name: Record formal contact with the designated Dwarven hold
